_doc: The test ships of the K page (scripts/combat/test_fights.gd). `build` is the loadout tests/tool_test_ships.gd rebuilds the design from (make); `stage` is the stage whose median enemy the ship is measured against; `pool` the parts it may carry; bands: the allowed ratio of the ship's Threat power to that median (pinned in tests/test_test_ships.gd).

pools._doc: Parts a player can really hold, by how late: early = the Rustfang/Concord stations and the starter recipes (data/drift.json stations, recipes.json); mid = + the Mk2 blueprints and the Meridian stock; late = + the shop blueprints (laser_mk3, pulse_mk3; drift.json shops) bought or found. Every test ship's guns and shields are from its pool (tests/test_test_ships.gd).
